question: What evidence is available on the relationship between sleep and stress among undergraduate nursing students?
scope: Five fictional records for workflow practice, not a completed real literature search.

criteria.text: The report concerns undergraduate nursing students, or reports their results separately within a mixed sample.
The report provides evidence about the relationship between sleep and stress.

records.title: Fictional practice: Sleep quality and stress in undergraduate nursing students
records.abstract: This fictional study included 120 undergraduate nursing students. Sleep quality and perceived stress were measured and their association was examined.

records.title: Fictional practice: Sleep and stress among employed nurses
records.abstract: All 80 participants were employed registered nurses; no nursing students participated. The study examined the relationship between sleep duration and stress.

DEMO01.text: FICTIONAL PRACTICE — NOT A REAL PAPER. Sleep quality and stress in undergraduate nursing students. Methods: All 120 participants were undergraduate nursing students. Sleep quality and perceived stress were assessed with questionnaires.
FICTIONAL PRACTICE. Results: Higher perceived stress was associated with poorer sleep quality. Table 1 presents the two measured constructs. This is only a teaching example, not a real study result.

DEMO03.text: FICTIONAL PRACTICE — NOT A REAL PAPER. Wellbeing in nursing training. This report describes a planned future survey of undergraduate nursing students. Data collection has not started.
FICTIONAL PRACTICE. The proposed survey covers sleep and stress. No findings on their relationship are reported because there are no collected data.

DEMO04.text: FICTIONAL PRACTICE — NOT A REAL PAPER. Sleep and stress in health students. The sample combined undergraduate nursing, medicine, and pharmacy students.
FICTIONAL PRACTICE. Results on the relationship between sleep and stress are reported only for the combined sample. Results for undergraduate nursing students are not reported separately.
